sentence: This project builds deep learning systems that change how they make predictions as the demands on limited edge platforms change.
This project builds a shared research infrastructure where researchers can run reproducible experiments on cybersecurity and privacy threats.
This project studies how to make AI techniques efficient enough for federated learning across many hardware platforms while protecting private data.
This project builds and tests a flexible stem for a total knee replacement that bends with knee motion to reduce mechanical stress.
This project studies how RNA editing in neurons lets fruitfly synapses and behavior adapt rapidly.
This project builds a computational cluster made of a mix of compute nodes to run machine learning and other research work.
This project tries to help deep learning models understand the meaning of source code so they can find bugs and debug software.
This project builds a cybersecurity concentration that gives access to a cyber range and industry-recognized credentials.
This project builds a game-based simulation with virtual agents to practice recognizing and responding to social engineering risks.
This project studies why metal parts made by laser powder-bed fusion fail from fatigue and builds a machine learning framework to predict fatigue life.
This project builds computer simulations from images of cancerous vessel networks to predict and explain altered blood flow in cancerous tissue.
This project studies how to test quantum computers and how quantum computing connects to cryptography, complexity theory and quantum gravity.
This project studies where language models fall short at personalized recommendation and collects datasets and evaluation methods to improve them.
This project builds instructional modules and laboratory activities that use robotics, digital twins and artificial intelligence for smart manufacturing.
This project studies how bacteria adapt when they form biofilm and how biofilm helps them resist predation by amoebae.
This project supports a conference on pervasive technologies that improve quality of life in assistive environments.
This project studies oxides with many types of cations to find lead-free materials that stretch or compress a lot under an electric field.
